upstream.environmentFunction: Extracted verbatim into the ocean adapter, with matching clock, state and wind convention.

newImplementation.renderer: One WebGL2 canvas for sky and a displaced 3D sea surface.
newImplementation.waves: 24 deterministic directionally distributed Gerstner components, plus 12 filtered micro-slope harmonics.
newImplementation.lighting: Fresnel environment reflection, directional sun/moon specular and continuous shared time-of-day.
newImplementation.sky: Original weather scalar density worker and optical functions drive an in-memory progressive hemispherical radiance/transmittance cache.
newImplementation.reflection: Visible sky and sea reflections use the same cache. This is a distant-environment approximation, without near-cloud reflection parallax.
newImplementation.foam: Instantaneous crest-compression appearance, not validated breaking-water or foam-transport physics.

browserEvidence.manualAssistantInspection: Actual rendered breeze, golden-hour and teal-water frames inspected. This is not user visual approval.
browserEvidence.performanceNote: Short software-renderer timing samples are diagnostic only; do not claim a target FPS for the user's GPU.

scopeNotImplemented: rain/snow/lightning particles on the ocean canvas
